tickets.objective: Correct the confirmatory public-reconstructibility and held-out-report contract, bind a machine-checkable report-access attestation, and preserve every already-frozen scientific input.
acceptance: The benchmark contract distinguishes public reconstructibility from controlled runtime injection.
The attestation binds the held-out report digest, record count, access claim, and repository scan.
No artifact makes a false secrecy or non-public-data claim.
The protocol digest is rederived mechanically without changing benchmark membership, arms, prompts, budgets, analysis rules, or outcomes.

tickets.objective: Amend the confirmatory activation and execution authority so an external trust root, one-shot activation, exact supervisor-source and report-attestation bindings, and pre-dispatch request/response caps are enforced; then reprovision every derived public authority artifact.
acceptance: The production trust root is external to the repository and cannot be replaced by a repository-only change.
Production activation is one-shot and a second activation attempt is rejected.
Execution authority binds the exact reviewed supervisor source and report-access attestation.
Per-request and per-response byte caps are enforced before dispatch and covered at exact boundaries.
The cost and evaluator contracts preserve the frozen complete-cost estimand and never convert blocked or incomplete evidence into FAIL or PASS.
Every derived manifest, launcher, capacity, trust, execution-authority, and preflight digest is mechanically regenerated after G1-134 and G1-135.
No scientific input changes and no production execution occurs in this ticket.

tickets.objective: Freeze the exact Lean and Mathlib runtime, verifier invocation, resource limits, and drift checks used for every confirmatory arm.
acceptance: Runtime and verifier identities are content-addressed.
Lean 4.33.1 is checked rather than inferred.
Any version, command, or environment drift blocks execution.

tickets.objective: Freeze ordinary and portfolio prompts, sampling, attempt and retry rules, result handling, and expected cost events at matched complete cost.
acceptance: Both baseline contracts are machine-readable and closed.
Attempt quotas and cost events are explicit.
Unregistered retries or prompt changes are rejected.

tickets.objective: Freeze product-only and multi-fidelity visibility, retry, verifier-call, and cost-event contracts, including predecessor provenance sufficient for paired scientific comparison.
acceptance: Every retry binds an authenticated predecessor completion.
Product visibility is explicit and arm-local.
Unregistered products, retries, or cost events are rejected.

tickets.objective: Freeze verified-chain admission, verifier, retry, within-problem memory, termination, and complete-cost boundaries.
acceptance: Only kernel-passing products can enter later prompts.
Every retry and admitted product is authority-bound.
No cross-problem or cross-arm product reuse is permitted.

tickets.objective: Freeze one observable complete-cost basis, per-arm ceiling, matching rule, retry estimand, and treatment of missing or unknowable usage.
acceptance: One model-usage basis applies to every arm and outcome.
Every expected event must be reconciled before evaluation.
Unknown or over-budget cost blocks credit rather than becoming zero.

tickets.objective: Require production evidence to contain an authenticated host-issued Lean verifier receipt that binds the exact source, candidate, runtime, dispatch, and result before evaluator projection.
acceptance: A caller-supplied LeanVerifierReceipt is insufficient for production credit.
An Ed25519-authenticated host receipt joins the exact source, candidate, runtime, dispatch, and verifier result.
Verifier evidence is persisted atomically, read back, replay-checked, and projected through the real evaluator boundary.
Draft and non-credit evidence remains explicitly non-production.
Adversarial tests reject fabricated PASS results and source, candidate, runtime, dispatch, or signature substitution.

tickets.objective: Expand the frozen protocol rules into one blinded one-shot paired manifest schema with every problem, arm, attempt, retry allowance, and budget preregistered; allow deterministic non-credit draft manifests but block production dispatch until the later execution-authority ticket.
acceptance: The manifest is derived only from the frozen protocol-rules digest.
All five arms are paired for every selected problem.
No attempt or retry can be added after dispatch begins.
Without an admissible execution-authority bundle the manifest is NON_CREDIT_DRAFT and dispatch is BLOCKED.

tickets.objective: Implement the confirmatory evaluator over evidence-bridge output only, with complete-cohort checks, four paired contrasts, Holm correction, complete-cost matching, and explicit terminal states.
acceptance: Only bridge-produced records are accepted.
PASS requires superiority over all four controls under the frozen rule.
BLOCKED and INCOMPLETE never become FAIL or PASS.

tickets.objective: Independently attack the merged confirmatory amendments at the real production boundaries before review or execution can proceed.
acceptance: The suite rejects repository-only external-trust-root substitution.
The suite rejects a second production activation.
The suite rejects fabricated host-verifier PASS evidence.
The suite confirms public report disclosure cannot mutate the frozen protocol or result.
The suite probes exact request and response byte-cap boundaries.
The complete relevant test suite passes against the merged amendments.

tickets.objective: Define Goal 2 as a falsifiable improver-of-improver contract with separated solver, memory, and improver components; matched R&D cost; fresh evaluation; and an explicit Goal-1 gate.
acceptance: The hypothesis and PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, and INCOMPLETE rules are machine-readable.
The contract binds untouched-solver comparison, fresh evaluation, and complete R&D cost.
No Goal-2 execution ticket may open when requires_goal1_pass is true and Goal 1 has no valid PASS.

tickets.objective: Independently review the exact amended frozen protocol, implementation, adversarial tests, evidence lineage, and unresolved assumptions without authoring or merging reviewed code.
acceptance: The review binds exact commit and protocol digests.
Every unresolved scientific or integrity finding is blocking.
The verdict is PASS, AMEND, or KILL and cannot create scientific credit.

tickets.objective: Run exactly one frozen confirmatory Goal-1 cohort and emit authority-backed evidence without changing any scientific input after manifest or dispatch start.
acceptance: The reviewed protocol and manifest digests are unchanged.
Every planned completion and cost event is reconciled.
The integration layer emits evidence only; it does not adjudicate the hypothesis.

tickets.objective: Report the confirmatory evaluator output and evidence digests without making any claim beyond PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or INCOMPLETE.
acceptance: The report references exact protocol, cohort, bridge, and evaluator evidence.
No missing or partial evidence is summarized as a negative result.
Goal 2 is unblocked only if its contract allows it and the reported result is valid PASS.
